definitions.explanation: The first half of a time period, event, game, or other divisible whole. Commonly used for halves of sports matches, decades, books, and similar.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{前半|ぜんはん}が{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The first half of the game ended.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{前半|ぜんはん}はテンポが{遅|おそ}かった。
examples.english: The first half of the movie had a slow pace.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{前半|ぜんはん}は{忙|いそが}しかったが、{後半|こうはん}は{少|すこ}し{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: The first half of this year was busy, but things calmed down a bit in the second half.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{前半|ぜんはん}{戦|せん} (first half of a match)
・{年|ねん}の{前半|ぜんはん} (first half of the year)
・{前半|ぜんはん}と{後半|こうはん} (first half and second half)

Often paired with its antonym {後半|こうはん} (second half). When referring to decades, {前半|ぜんはん} means the earlier years — for example, 2020{年代|ねんだい}{前半|ぜんはん} means the early 2020s.
